设置参数`offsetTop`用于控制下滑触发元素相对页面顶部锚定的像素距离阈值.en-us: Use `offsetTop` to set the top offset threshold for affixing during downward scrolling.

设置参数`offsetBottom`用于控制上滑触发元素相对页面底部锚定的像素距.en-us: Use `offsetBottom` to set the bottom offset threshold for affixing during upward scrolling.

设置参数`target`为固钉设置锚定参考的局部容器。.en-us: Use `target` to set a local reference container for affixing.
